# Species traits — synthetic fixture for testing

trait_intelligent = {
	cost = 2
	initial = yes
	randomized = yes
	modification = yes
	category = normal
	opposites = { "trait_simple_minded" }
	modifier = {
		research_speed_factor = 0.10
		leader_experience_gain = 0.25
	}
	ai_weight = {
		weight = 5
	}
}

trait_natural_physicists = {
	cost = 1
	initial = yes
	randomized = yes

	}

}
